'''Decklists''' on this wiki are the published Star Wars CCG constructed 60s, collated from championship sheets, Decipher.com, [[DeckTech]], [[Game Players Network]], and other fan sites.

This wiki is the reading copy. Historical hosts stay in Sources. Championship hubs keep Dark and Light cells for every published pair. Fan-site dumps keep the published title.

== Collections ==

=== Championships and modern events ===

Event hubs on [[List of SWCCG tournaments]] and [[Championships]] link dest 60s in Dark and Light cells. Player pages list those dests under Tournament Results.

=== Decipher Deck Designs ===

[[Decipher deck designs]] is the archive of the 8 June 2001 decipher.com Deck Designs index: tournament rows and general articles Decipher published there.

=== DeckTech ===

[[DeckTech]] (decktech.net) was the late-1990s–2000s deck-list and tournament-report desk. Stephen Skilton's [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/ SWCCG Decktech Archives] keep those posts. Dest copies live on [[DeckTech decks]] and [[DeckTech tournament reports]]. Tournament reports often name what people played and sometimes include a 60; those fill event hubs and player pages as dests land.

=== Game Players Network ===

[[Game Players Network]] hosted a rated, user-submitted catalog (Standard, Theme/Fun, Scenario) around 2001–2005. Those lists start on [[Game Players Network decks]] (oldest remaining listing page first).

=== Other fan sites ===

Other published lists sit on [[Corellian Engineering Corporation (fan site)]], [[Red 32's Star Wars CCG Site]], [[Trandosite]], and [[:Category:Fan sites]].

== Index tables ==

* '''Tournament rows:''' Date, Format, Event, Finish, Player, Dark, Light. Event is the hub. Dark and Light are dest articles; pipe text is the Objective 0-side or starting site. Oldest-first on source archives ([[Decipher deck designs]], [[DeckTech decks]]). Newest-first on player Tournament Results.
* '''General rows:''' Date, Format, Title, Side, Author. Title is the dest.
